title: Figure 17. A Block Diagram of a Typical Link Budget (HFGW communications)
description: Block diagram headed "An end-to-end power link budget from the transmitter to the receiver must be also calculated to support a communications link design", with the integral equation for output signal So. A chain of blocks Si → μeg → Rx → T → Rr → μge → So is grouped into "Transmitter Terms", "Link Loss" and "Receiver Terms", with labels such as "Input Signal Power", "EM/GW Conversion Efficiency", "Propagation Losses (Transmission Factor)" and "Output Signal Power". Caption: "Figure 17. A Block Diagram of a Typical Link Budget".
